mode.hint:
HW: the keyboard types by itself.
Driver: EasyRazer types for it; the keyboard types only while the app runs.

Driver mode only:
• Rapid Trigger
• Snap Tap
• Live key depth
• Macros not written to the keyboard

footer: EasyRazer is an unofficial project, not affiliated with Razer Inc.

common.selectHow: Click, Ctrl+click or drag a box

actuation.title: Actuation
actuation.unconfirmed: Not confirmed: the keyboard has {v} mm
actuation.failed: Not applied or not confirmed for {n} keys (hover the red ones)
actuation.applied: Applied until the keyboard is unplugged
actuation.unsavedKey: Applied but not saved to the keyboard

snap.title: Snap Tap
snap.empty: Select two or more keys on the map, such as A and D, and group them.
snap.firmwarePair: In HW mode the keyboard runs one pair: the first two keys of the first group, rule Last

hints.last: While several are held, the newest press types. Release it and the previous one types again.
hints.neutral: While several are held, none types. When one is left, it types again.
hints.deeper: While several are held, the deepest one types.

bindings.moveText: It is on {from} now; that combination types its own key again.
bindings.other: Bound to something EasyRazer does not edit yet: a service function. Pick an action to replace it.
bindings.writeMacros: The macro “{names}” is not in the keyboard yet. In HW mode the keyboard plays only macros in its memory, so the macro has to be saved there for the binding to work. Its flash memory wears out with rewrites.
bindings.noMacros: Create a macro in Macros first
bindings.unconfirmed: Not confirmed: the keyboard kept another binding

macros.name: Name
macros.pick: Pick a macro or create a new one
macros.empty: Empty: record key presses or add steps with the buttons below
macros.recordingHint: Press keys: they go into the macro, not to the system. Stop with the Stop button.
macros.size: Takes {n} B of the keyboard memory
macros.sizeFree: Takes {n} B of the keyboard memory, {free} B free
macros.boundTo: Bound to keys: {keys}. Unbind them first.
macros.notWritten: Not in the keyboard: does not play in HW mode
macros.applied: Saved in EasyRazer; already plays in Driver mode

lighting.dlWarning: ⚠ Windows Dynamic Lighting controls the lighting — keyboard effects are not visible.
lighting.connect: Connect the keyboard to see its effects.
lighting.customWarning: ⚠ The custom layout is not saved to keyboard memory: it works while EasyRazer is running (including minimized to the tray).

autostart.title: Start EasyRazer with Windows?
autostart.text: It will stay in the tray and bring the lighting back by itself.

close.title: Close the window
close.text: In the tray EasyRazer keeps watching the keyboard and brings the lighting back after a replug.
close.unapplied: Changes not applied will be lost.

write.title: Save to keyboard memory?
write.text: The settings will stay in the keyboard and work without EasyRazer. Its flash memory wears out with rewrites — don't do this too often.

settings.confirmWrite: Ask before saving to keyboard memory
settings.unverifiedWrites: Write to keyboards not yet checked on hardware (RAM only)

dev.title: Developer tools
dev.uncensoredHint: Includes macro contents, profile names and the serial number

drawer.title: Console
drawer.empty: Commands and replies. A flash write asks first.
drawer.confirmSlot: Write to flash (slot {slot}). Enter to send, Esc to cancel
drawer.confirmFlash: Write to flash. Enter to send, Esc to cancel
drawer.confirmUnknown: Unknown write, may reach the flash. Enter to send, Esc to cancel
drawer.confirmUnusual: Unusual value {value}: {help} Enter to send, Esc to cancel

devices.forgetConfirm: Forget {name}? Its profiles and macros are deleted from the app.

status.offline: {name} is not connected — only profiles are available
status.synapse: Synapse (RazerAppEngine) is running. Close it, including its tray icon, or it will overwrite the settings.
status.unsupported: This Razer keyboard model is not supported (PID {pid}).
status.unverified: Connected: {model}, profile “{profile}”. This model has not been checked on hardware: the app only reads it unless allowed in Settings, and never writes its memory

backend.synapseRunning: Synapse is running — close it, including its tray icon
backend.importFormat: This file is from a newer EasyRazer
backend.busy: The keyboard is busy, try again
backend.macroUnwritten: The macro is not in the keyboard: write it in Macros, or write the binding
backend.customNotSaved: The custom layout cannot be saved to the keyboard
backend.lastSlot: The last slot cannot be freed
backend.onlyProfile: The only profile cannot be deleted
backend.emptyName: A profile name cannot be empty
backend.nameTaken: A profile with this name already exists
backend.unverified: {model} has not been checked on hardware: turn on writes to such keyboards in Settings
backend.unverifiedFlash: {model} has not been checked on hardware: its memory is not written yet

profiles.legend: ⏻ — starts without the app · {combo} — next profile
profiles.removeText: The profile goes from the app and from the keyboard's memory.
